catalog_resolution.reuse_note: Unchanged public entities and same general-working-surface matching rule as candidate-mart-clarify-position-2026102802. Captured source pages remain at their original paths; no synthetic rankings or new captures claimed.

catalogue_assessment.rule: One individual flat board with a rectangular (square or oblong) working surface; ordinary lids, serving use, folded lips, hanging holes and end handles do not disqualify an otherwise useful board. Exclude multi-board or tableware packages and standalone holders. Rounded corners are acceptable. A double-sided board pictured from both sides is one board, not a set. No exact model, colour or aspect-ratio matching. A single board with a rectangular main working surface remains acceptable when it adds holding fixtures. Shape refers to the working surface, not a projecting handle or fixture.
catalogue_assessment.evidence: Both complete 48-result native pages, all 96 public listing images and titles screened; shared real products deduplicated by ASIN. Independent review found the general-shape modifier ambiguous and the square claim for p_97def538980c unsupported. The former is clarified in both public instructions; the latter is accepted as a practical substitute from its visible rectangular board rather than excluded without evidence.

construct.belief_before: Either the visible cutting board or the visible cooking pan could be the requested spare.
construct.belief_after: The right-hand referent is the cutting board; choose one practical individual rectangular cutting board.
construct.required_behavior_change: Use the wearer-relative spatial answer to choose the board and leave no pan or extra item in the final cart.
construct.no_update_failure: Guess the pan or retain ambiguity without using the available answer.
construct.overupdate_failure: Buy both kitchen items, or impose an unrequested exact colour, material or brand.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The answer names only right. The physical view is needed to link that direction to the board; both referent families exist in the real search window. A single well-aimed frame may suffice, which is acceptable for this static-reference control.

screening.source_observations: Reviewed 10-second overview, 1-second samples from 40–65 seconds and native views. Original recording differs from all 195 formal tasks. Reused the existing verified rectangular-board and round-pan public catalogue; no claim of new live search capture.

changes: Expressed the authored purpose of a second preparation area and removed duplicate wording; referents, spatial answer, shape rule, website and all legal endings unchanged.
repair.retained_evidence: Sealed first-pass blind solution remains applicable; second pass checks the revised public wording.

repair_history.repair: scene_not_necessary: added natural broader real search rounds and/or neutralised leaking wording

residual_shortcut_check.text_only_query: The released words ('I'm cooking and need a second one of these two kitchen items ... one individual item of the same general shape ... any brand, colour, material or size; no sets') name neither item and give no purpose that separates a board from a pan. 'I'm cooking' leans slightly toward a pan if anything. A no-image agent should ask; the canonical answer 'the one on my right' cannot be resolved without the frames. A guessing agent would pick roughly evenly between 'cutting board' and 'frying pan'.
residual_shortcut_check.text_only_accept_fraction_estimate: About 40-50%: a 'cutting board' guess lands on an accepted item about 40 of 48 times (40 of 48 board-query results accepted after this recheck), and a pan guess never does. With roughly even guessing, that is a coin flip or worse. The old wording was near 100%.
residual_shortcut_check.remaining_issue: None from the wording. The only text-side residue is that 'cutting board' is the more common kitchen-spare guess, which keeps text-only success near half. That is inherent to a two-referent clarify task and is not a leak.
residual_shortcut_check.proposed_fix: None needed. No search-coverage change: the window already holds one full real board query and one full real pan query.

addressed_review: 2026-10-31 独立 Coding Agent 画面必要性审核（necessity-reviewer-A，.scratch/necessity-20261030/reviews/candidate-mart-clarify-position-2026102804.json）判为文字捷径：Frames show a pan being stirred on the induction hob and a red/salmon rectangular cutting board at the right edge. The scene decides board vs pan; within boards it adds only 'rectangular', and the text allows any brand, colour, material or size. 修复方向：Remove 'for a second preparation area' and 'working surface' so the wording fits pan and board equally (e.g. 'another one of these two kitchen items, same general shape, any brand/colour/material/size, no sets'); then only the right-hand position in the frames decides the referent.
